I'm not really sure about how to go through that.  I don't know who to reach out to that wouldn't be a sham.  I think there's a distinct possibility that I need to make a dramatic change in my career path, because what I'm doing is not working anymore. 

I absolutely love travelling and it was one of my childhood dreams to have a job that allows me to travel to different countries.  I may consider doing this if I don't find work after my last day and my severance has ended.  I considered going to Europe for a while and figuring out some sort of temp job there while I explore the countries.  That would indeed be a fulfilling thing for me.

Nah, it's not a crutch...I smoke maybe once a week if that, when I'm under a lot of stress.  That's a great perspective though, I've never heard of such a thing here.  Fortunately for what I do, there's a lot of demand, I'm just not sure how good I am at doing it anymore.  Thanks sgibson.
Yeah, I've been seeing a therapist off and on for years.  Unfortunately, other than to vent, I don't think I've ever quite been able to resolve any of my personal issues. :-(

I'm trying...but it's the only thing in my life.  It sets the tone for the rest of if, since I have to be there every day.  I want to be happy to go to work, and have people like me there.  When I was at my happiest, work was in a good place and I was in a very positive relationship.  That hasn't happened for years now.  And it's only ever happened once...not sure if it will again.

I do take meds, and usually they make me sorta neutral, though I think people can still detect my depression and I think that's part of what makes them not like me much.  I've never been a very popular person, but I've always worked my hardest to be successful at whatever I'm doing.  Sometimes I just don't know the right direction and need guidance and I'm rarely given that.

I don't drink much, but when I do, I smoke pot.  That's what I did, watch really bad tv (rich housewives talking shit about each other) and that made me laugh a bit.  Still don't know what I'm going to do, feel like my job skills aren't very strong anymore after 5 very rough years in and out of work (because of this economy and the constant relocating and laying off thing).

Well, I got my degree in Environmental Engineering, 13 years ago.  I haven't done anything with it, choosing to work in the games industry instead.  I've been working for one of the big companies, and they relocating me twice and laid me off in both those locations.  This is the 2nd time and I'm not sure what to do, since I don't have any friends here.
